description: Compromised office workstation hammers canary-1's SSH with wrong passwords from a non-privileged identity — classic rule-5710 (SSH invalid-user / auth-failure) territory. The signal is the burst of failed auth events on canary-1's sshd.

steps.cmd:
for pw in hunter2 password123 letmein admin secret qwerty; do
  sshpass -p "$pw" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no \
    -o ConnectTimeout=3 -o PreferredAuthentications=password \
    -o NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1 \
    root@web-1 true 2>&1 | head -1 || true
done
steps.stdout_tail:
root@web-1: Permission denied (publickey,password).
root@web-1: Permission denied (publickey,password).
root@web-1: Permission denied (publickey,password).
